title: HRDEM 1m DTM - Ruisseau Charron near Polyvalente Sainte-Therese / Stade Richard-Garneau
why_replaced_previous: Previous file DEM_Ruisseau_Charron_Ste_Therese_CDEM16m.tif was a coarse ~16 m CDEM extract and not suitable for creek/channel modeling. This product is LiDAR-based HRDEM 1 m DTM clipped to the stadium/polyvalente reach shown by the user.
source_product: NRCan High Resolution Digital Elevation Model (HRDEM) Mosaic 1m - DTM
recommended_use: Use the UTM18 (EPSG:2959) GeoTIFF in HEC-RAS / CAD / GIS for existing-condition terrain. The AOI covers the Ruisseau Charron corridor between Polyvalente Sainte-Therese and Stade Richard-Garneau, extending south beyond Boulevard du Domaine for existing/future modeling.
notes: DTM = bare-earth terrain (preferred for hydraulic modeling).
Buildings/vegetation are removed in DTM; use DSM asset if canopy/structure surface is needed.
Verify channel invert with survey; LiDAR may not resolve submerged bed accurately.
